Lesson  
When you have started a lesson, you will see one of the following options. 
 
Figure 70 Acknowledge 
 
Figure 71 Type Question 
 
Figure 70, this is a simple text page, typically this will be shown at the start of a 
lesson to show the lessons objectives. Once you have finished you may proceed 
by pressing continue. 
Figure 71, to answer the question you must press on the answer text field and 
enter your answer. You are permitted to add redundant text and your answer is 
not case sensitive. You may discard your answer by pressing the X on the right 
of the text field. Once you are done press the check answer.
